name: Clay
description: All-in-one data enrichment, web scraping, and GTM workflow platform for sales and marketing teams.

evidence.claim: Every request to the Clay Public API must include a Clay API key in the clay-api-key header.
Clay has an official agent plugin, CLI, and MCP capabilities allowing integration with AI coding tools and chat interfaces.

notes: Clay provides both a Public API and CLI/agent plugin support (including MCP servers), authenticating via a Clay API key passed via headers (clay-api-key).
